verdicts.reason: Checks `_etag` being cleared when a 200 has no ETag; the instruction names `_etag` and specifies this.
Only checks that a 304 emits no warnings, which the instruction requires.
Checks the instruction-named `_config` identity and `_last_fetched_at` update, plus no calls to the existing error logger `_log_error`, as the instruction specifies.
The instruction explicitly says a 304 resets `_consecutive_refresh_failures` to 0.
The instruction specifies that a malformed 200 leaves `_etag` unchanged; the rest checks only the request flow and that no warnings are raised.
The instruction specifies that `_etag` starts as None and is set from the 200's ETag header.
Checks the If-None-Match header seen at the HTTP boundary, as the instruction specifies.
The instruction specifies `_etag` is None when the response has no ETag header.
Uses only instruction-named members (`_worker`, `_force_refresh_event`, `_worker_awaken`, `_shutdown`, `_followup_refresh_at`) and checks the specified deadline of about monotonic()+2s.
